root_cause_analysis.symptom: On mobile 390×844 viewport, normal paragraph text and inline tool-call cards (Bash command line, CronList output) extend past the right edge of the visible viewport / message-card; on desktop 1440×900 the messageContent wrapper has scrollWidth (816) > clientWidth (800) with overflowX:visible (no clipping at this layer).
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Two co-conspirators: (1) MessageView.messageContent.maxWidth is bound to the static field layout.maxWidth (= 800 on web, evaluated once at module load via getMaxLayoutWidth() in layout.ts:6-21) — not reactive to window resize. (2) Three of the four message-wrapper style blocks in MessageView.tsx — userMessageContainer (217-223), userMessageBubble (224-231), and toolContainer (249-251) — lack the overflow:hidden + maxWidth:100% discipline that was added to agentMessageContainer in commit a59b3795. The prior fix only protected agent messages and the table; the rest of the family was missed.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: a59b3795 (2026-03-25, 'fix: table font mismatch and mobile overflow on web') is the prior partial fix that established the pattern but did not propagate it to all sibling wrappers; the static layout.maxWidth has been in tree since the project's initial layout.ts.
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: a59b3795 was scoped narrowly to the user-reported table overflow. The author touched only the surfaces strictly needed for that bug: agentMessageContainer + the table block + minWidth:0 on messageContent. layout.ts's static getMaxLayoutWidth() predates a59b3795 and was not on the radar.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: On mobile (390 viewport), a non-clipping wrapper lets any child element with intrinsic width > 390 (a long inline-code span, a Bash command line, a long URL) bleed past the visible bounds. On desktop, scrollWidth (816) > clientWidth (800) at messageContent reveals that even the cap is being violated by 16px somewhere in children — but because messageContent.overflowX = visible, the 16px is not clipped and feeds upward until the depth-4 ancestor's overflow:hidden absorbs it. On a narrow desktop or with sidebar transitions, the static 800 cap doesn't shrink to fit the available column.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: a59b3795 (2026-03-25): partial fix landed. Cycles 1-4 (2026-04-24 to 2026-04-25): not investigated. Cycle 5 (2026-04-25): QA verified <table> only and PASSED 5.8; user pushed back the same day (spec line 2851-2856 correction-note added).
